summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) to serve DHCP on lan-a (eth2, 10.50.10.0/24) and node2 (OPNsense) to serve DHCP on lan-b (vtnet2/opt1, 10.50.20.0/24), each handing out its own gateway address as the host's default route. node3 (behind node1) and node4 (behind node2) now obtain their addressing dynamically from the router in front of them instead of static configuration. All four nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory evidence protocol, with boot-identity change confirmed and full DHCP/routing recovery verified on each.
actions_performed: Mapped real L2 wiring by testing point-to-point addresses/ARP: node1.eth2<->node3.ens7 (lan-a), node2.vtnet2<->node4.ens7 (lan-b), node1.eth1<->node2.vtnet1 (unused inter-router link)
Configured VyOS node1: static 10.50.10.254/24 on eth2, DHCP server shared-network LAN-A with pool 10.50.10.100-200, default-router/name-server options; committed and saved to config.boot

Configured OPNsense node2 via config.xml edits: added opt1 interface on vtnet2 (10.50.20.254/24), dnsmasq dhcp_ranges for opt1 (10.50.20.100-200), a pass filter rule, and fixed dnsmasq's global listen-interface list (lan,opt1) so DHCP actually served vtnet2; applied via configctl interface reconfigure/filter reload/dnsmasq restart
Verified node3 obtained 10.50.10.100/24 via DHCP from node1 with node1 as default gateway on that link

Verified node4 obtained 10.50.20.167/24 via DHCP from node2 with node2 as default gateway on that link (required a systemd-networkd restart on node4 to trigger DHCP retry after the dnsmasq listen-interface fix)
Captured healthy baseline (boot_id/boottime plus interface/service/lease state) on all four nodes
Restarted node1, node2, node3, node4 sequentially one at a time, polling exec availability after each and confirming boot identity changed on every node

Post-restart verification on each node: VyOS eth2 address and DHCP pool intact, OPNsense opt1 interface and dnsmasq listen-config intact, node3 and node4 automatically re-acquired their lan-a/lan-b addresses and default routes with successful pings to their respective gateways

evidence.requirement: node1 (VyOS) serves lan-a addressing and hands itself out as default gateway
evidence.summary: DHCP server LAN-A configured with 10.50.10.254 as default-router; show interfaces confirms eth2=10.50.10.254/24 and DHCP pool active with 101 available addresses

evidence.requirement: node2 (OPNsense) serves lan-b addressing and hands itself out as default gateway
evidence.summary: config.xml updated with opt1 interface (10.50.20.254/24) and dhcp_ranges for opt1; dnsmasq listen-interface fixed to lan,opt1 and confirmed generated dnsmasq.conf lists interface=vtnet0,vtnet2

evidence.requirement: node3 obtains addressing from node1 (router in front of it) rather than static config
evidence.summary: node3 ens7 shows dynamic DHCP lease 10.50.10.100/24 with default route via 10.50.10.254 (node1), and successful ping to gateway

evidence.requirement: node4 obtains addressing from node2 (router in front of it) rather than static config
evidence.summary: node4 ens7 shows dynamic DHCP lease 10.50.20.167/24 with default route via 10.50.20.254 (node2), and successful ping to gateway

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: boot_id 7668189d... before, ack of reboot command, boot_id 072e70a3... after (changed), show interfaces/dhcp stats confirm config survived, node3 still reachable via renewed lease

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: kern.boottime sec=1788675241 before, reboot ack, kern.boottime sec=1788675666 after (changed), opt1/dnsmasq config intact post-restart, node4 still able to ping gateway

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: boot_id 2b3a8d87... before, reboot connection-closed ack, boot_id f415ed64... after (changed), ens7 automatically re-acquired 10.50.10.100/24 with working gateway ping

evidence.requirement: node4 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: boot_id 88feca03... before, reboot connection-closed ack, boot_id 37a9629e... after (changed), ens7 automatically re-acquired 10.50.20.167/24 with working gateway ping
